WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM telescopes
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.telescope_count,
    CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / t.total as share,
    AVG(CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / t.total) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN total_count t
),
results AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    share - avg_share as difference
  FROM stats
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  difference
FROM results
WHERE difference >= (
  SELECT MIN(difference) 
  FROM (
    SELECT difference FROM results ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
  )
)
ORDER BY difference DESC
